name: io.github.peleduri/gop
title: gop: who can make code run where
description: Read-only evidence graph of who can make code run where in a GitHub Enterprise.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the folder that holds your graph.json read-only at /data in the container

graph_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds graph.json (written by gop collect). Keep it out of shared or synced folders.

packageArguments.name: --graph
packageArguments.description: The graph file inside the mounted folder

graph_file.description: File name of the graph in that folder
